startUrls.title: PDF URLs
startUrls.description: Public http(s) links to PDF files, e.g. https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/CSWP/NIST.CSWP.29.pdf. Non-PDF and failed URLs return an error item and are not charged.

outputMode.title: Output
enumTitles: RAG chunks (one item per chunk, with page citations)
Document (one item per PDF, full Markdown)
outputMode.description: 'chunks' = one dataset item per RAG chunk with headingPath, page range and citation (best for vector DBs). 'pages' = one item per page. 'document' = one item per PDF with full Markdown. The full Markdown is always also saved to the key-value store.

chunkSizeChars.title: Chunk size (characters)
chunkSizeChars.description: Target maximum characters per chunk in 'chunks' mode (~4 characters ≈ 1 token; 2000 ≈ 500 tokens).

chunkOverlapChars.title: Chunk overlap (characters)
chunkOverlapChars.description: Characters repeated between consecutive chunks when a long section must be split.

ocrMode.title: OCR
enumTitles: Auto (OCR only pages without a text layer)
ocrMode.description: 'auto' OCRs only pages without a text layer (recommended). 'off' never OCRs. 'force' OCRs every page. Each OCR'd page costs $0.004 extra.

maxPagesPerDocument.title: Max pages per document
maxPagesPerDocument.description: Only the first N pages of each PDF are converted. Pages beyond this are skipped and not charged.

removeHeadersFooters.title: Remove page headers & footers
removeHeadersFooters.description: Drop running headers, footers and page numbers so chunks contain only body text.
